/* 1. Fallback za slike koje ne postoje: tamni gradijent + „Slika uskoro“ */
function fb(img) {
  const p = img.parentElement;
  const bad = () => {
    img.style.display = 'none';
    if (!$('.nf', p)) { const s = document.createElement('span'); s.className = 'nf'; s.textContent = 'Slika uskoro'; p.prepend(s); }
  };
  const ok = () => { img.style.display = ''; const s = $('.nf', p); if (s) s.remove(); };
  img.addEventListener('error', bad);
  img.addEventListener('load', ok);
  if (img.complete && !img.naturalWidth) bad();
}
$$('img').forEach(fb);

/* 2. Mobilni meni */
const setMenu = o => {
  hd.classList.toggle('open', o);
  burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', o);
  burger.setAttribute('aria-label', o ? 'Zatvori meni' : 'Otvori meni');

/* 3. Skrol: sticky header, progres, parallax, dugme za vrh */
const heroBg = $('.hero-bg'), pars = $$('[data-par]');
let tick = false;
function onScroll() {
  const y = scrollY, h = root.scrollHeight - innerHeight;
  hd.classList.toggle('sc', y > 40);
  bar.style.transform = `scaleX(${h > 0 ? y / h : 0})`;
  topBtn.classList.toggle('show', y > 700);
  if (!rm) {
    if (y < innerHeight * 1.2) heroBg.style.setProperty('--py', y * 0.3 + 'px');
    pars.forEach(p => {
      const r = p.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      p.style.setProperty('--p', (r.top + r.height / 2 - innerHeight / 2) * -0.06 + 'px');

  tick = false;
}
addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(onScroll); } }, { passive: true });
onScroll();
topBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: rm ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }));

/* 4. Reveal pri skrolovanju (IntersectionObserver) + stagger */
$$('.stg').forEach(c => $$('.rv', c).forEach((e, i) => e.style.setProperty('--d', (i * 0.12 + (c.classList.contains('hero-in') ? 1.5 : 0)) + 's')));
const io = new IntersectionObserver((es, o) => es.forEach(e => {
  if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); o.unobserve(e.target); }
}), { threshold: 0.15 });
$$('.rv').forEach(e => io.observe(e));

/* 5. Aktivan link trenutne sekcije */
const links = $$('nav a:not(.btn)');
const so = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => {
  if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
  const m = links.find(a => a.hash === '#' + e.target.id);

}), { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });
$$('main section[id]').forEach(s => so.observe(s));

const M = $('#modal'), mi = $('#m-i'), mt = $('#m-t'), md = $('#m-d'), mn = $('#m-n'), ms = $('#m-s');
const xBtn = $('.x', M);
fb(mi);

  mn.textContent = el.dataset.n || g('.num') || 'SA TERENA';
  ms.textContent = el.dataset.s || g('.tag');
  ms.hidden = !ms.textContent;
  M.dataset.from = '1';
  M._last = document.activeElement;
  M.hidden = false;
  root.classList.add('lock');
  xBtn.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
function closeM() {
  if (M.hidden) return;
  M.hidden = true;
  root.classList.toggle('lock',!document.getElementById('gm').hidden);

}
document.addEventListener('click', e => {

});

});

if (matchMedia('(hover:hover)').matches && !rm) document.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
